risk_ranking: Not assigned; requires competent process, plumbing, electrical and water-quality reviewers. No severity/occurrence/detectability score is inferred here.

failure_modes.failure: incompatible or unknown source enters equalisation
failure_modes.safe_state: isolate source; divert batch to authorized waste; no release

failure_modes.hazard: overflow, loss of supply, pump starvation
required_prevention: oversized capture area to be engineered
failure_modes.safe_state: stop feed and pump; isolate; overflow only to authorized waste
failure_modes.verification: progressive blockage test and service task timing

failure_modes.safe_state: expire and divert batch; clean/requalify as required
stop inflow/feed; route overflow to authorized waste

failure_modes.failure: feed pump dry-run, loss of prime or dead-head
failure_modes.hazard: heat, equipment damage, loss of treatment
failure_modes.verification: dry-run and blocked-discharge test per manufacturer envelope

failure_modes.failure: UF membrane breach or integrity loss
failure_modes.hazard: untreated contamination passes to product stream
failure_modes.safe_state: quarantine outlet and divert; no end-use release
failure_modes.verification: deliberately seeded integrity fault and no-release proof

failure_modes.safe_state: close reclaimed outlet; divert or quarantine

failure_modes.failure: GAC biofilm detachment or breakthrough (cassette B)
failure_modes.safe_state: quarantine batch; replace/clean media and requalify
failure_modes.verification: aged media, restart and biofilm challenge

failure_modes.failure: ozone leak or off-gas control failure (cassette B)
failure_modes.hazard: worker/user inhalation exposure and material damage
required_prevention: enclosure, ventilation, off-gas destructor and rated materials
failure_modes.safe_state: hardware shutdown and safe evacuation/ventilation procedure
failure_modes.verification: not in A0; only after signed ozone hazard review

failure_modes.failure: quarantine release occurs without valid evidence
failure_modes.verification: stale, mismatched, missing and contradictory evidence challenges

failure_modes.hazard: microbial regrowth and loss of intended-use quality
required_detection: age/temperature/turnover records and scheduled outlet sampling
failure_modes.safe_state: isolate tank, empty/clean under procedure, requalify

required_prevention: approved air gap/break tank if make-up needed
required_detection: independent plumbing inspection and cross-connection testing
failure_modes.safe_state: isolate affected supplies; do not rely on software valve
close reclaimed outlet, stop feed, retain quarantine
failure_modes.verification: power interruption, brownout and reboot test

required_detection: reject meter and tank level reconciliation
failure_modes.safe_state: stop process and hold residuals in containment
failure_modes.verification: port-trace and reject mass/volume balance challenge

failure_modes.failure: sensor stale, drifting or common-mode failure
failure_modes.hazard: false process permissive or bad evidence
failure_modes.safe_state: abstain and isolate if the channel is safety-critical
failure_modes.verification: stale, biased, disconnected and common-mode negative controls

review_required: formal HAZID/HAZOP by competent process engineer
plumbing cross-connection review by qualified local professional
electrical risk and protection review by qualified professional
chemical/ozone safety case before cassette B is constructed
water-quality hazard analysis and intended-use criteria via Mycelix #6100 and appropriate laboratory/authority
independent verification of physical barriers and failure response
